name: H-ATLAS J090740.0-004200 (Hubble)
blurb: H-ATLAS J090740.0-004200, a gravitationally lensed dusty galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: sdss090740004160-hubble
story: Here an elliptical galaxy in the foreground bends the light of a dust-shrouded galaxy far behind it, one of the first gravitational lenses found by the Herschel ATLAS survey. The hidden galaxy is caught in a fierce burst of star formation, and Hubble's sharp view helps astronomers reconstruct its true shape.
